comments.body: also, does podman machine default automatically update on podman updates, if not, is there a way to?

please read the docs on your follow up question.  as was said earlier, please dont abuse this mechanism as a free support mechanism.  as for the feature request, we have no intentions of supporting an os that is not designed for this purpose.  you can design your own as long as you do everything our OS did (which im afraid is not documented).  As such on both accounts, closing
